en.title: Plane crash in Gwinnett County resulted in one fatality and one injury
en.dek: Gwinnett County officials reported one person dead and one person injured following a plane crash
facts: One fatality was reported in Gwinnett County
One injury was reported in Gwinnett County
Police maintained an active scene in Gwinnett County
An investigation into the plane crash is underway
body: Gwinnett County officials stated that one person died and one person was injured after the plane crash, according to Atlanta News First.
11Alive.com reported that there was one dead and one hurt in the Gwinnett County plane crash.
Police maintained an active scene in Gwinnett County following the plane crash, 11Alive.com reported.
The investigation into the plane crash in Gwinnett County is ongoing, 11Alive.com stated.
en.context: The incident occurred in Gwinnett County, and authorities have established an active police scene at the location, according to 11Alive.com.
